name: Flipbook Studio
description: Draw frame by frame with onion skin, preview the loop, and export a GIF or PNG frame sequence; works stay on this device
help: Pick a fixed canvas size when creating a work; every frame keeps that size. Works and each frame are saved separately in ToolForge on this device, offline.
Draw on the current frame with the brush or eraser. You can import your own picture into the current frame; it is fitted inside the canvas, centered, and placed over what is already there.
In the timeline you can add blank frames, duplicate, delete, and drag thumbnails to reorder. A work always keeps at least one frame, and a duplicated frame is independent from the original.
Onion skin shows the previous frame semi-transparently as a drawing guide. It never appears in exports.
Undo/redo covers drawing, imports, adding, deleting and reordering frames, even after switching frames (⌘/Ctrl+Z, ⇧⌘/Ctrl+Shift+Z).
Each frame stays 20–2000 ms in 10 ms steps. Playback loops with this timing, the same as the export. Switching tools, editing, or leaving the tool stops playback.

GIF export composites each frame on the chosen background and loops forever. A PNG sequence keeps transparency and is written to the folder you choose. Exports can be cancelled and never change the work.
Limits: up to 120 frames and 40 MB of frame data per work, up to 20 works; imported pictures up to 20 MB and 24 megapixels.
